name: closure_survives_return
source: fun outer() { var value = "captured"; fun inner() { print value; } return inner; } var f = outer(); f();
requirement: Function closure retains its enclosing environment

name: closure_mutates_captured_variable
source: fun counter() { var n=0; fun inc() { n=n+1; return n; } return inc; } var c=counter(); print c(); print c();
requirement: Closure writes resolve to the captured binding

name: independent_closures
source: fun counter() { var n=0; fun inc() { n=n+1; return n; } return inc; } var a=counter(); var b=counter(); print a(); print a(); print b();
requirement: Separate calls create independent captured state

name: textbook_later_local_declaration
source: var a="global"; { fun showA() { print a; } showA(); var a="block"; showA(); }
requirement: Lab 8 example 1: lexical binding precedes later local declaration

name: textbook_assignment_changes_binding
source: var a="global"; { fun showA() { print a; } showA(); a="block"; showA(); }
requirement: Lab 8 example 2: assignment changes the resolved global

name: textbook_global_redeclaration
source: var a="global"; fun showA() { print a; } showA(); var a="change_block"; showA();
requirement: Lab 8 example 3: reference policy permits global redeclaration

name: nested_environment_depth
source: { var a=1; { var b=2; { a=a+b; print a; } } print a; }
requirement: Resolver follows multiple environment links for reads and writes

name: distinct_local_names_allowed
source: { var a=1; var b=2; print a+b; }

name: return_in_top_level_block
